# REGEN Quest Review — human-led, not an approval record

> Do not include personal data, identifying allegations, sensitive safety reports or unconsented organizational records in this public repository.
> Passing CI is NOT authorization to execute a quest. This PR template is not a substitute for verified GitHub reviews or branch protection.

## Proposal and version
- Quest ID:
- Exact proposal version:
- Link to the redacted draft:
- Conflicts of interest and recusal:

## Consent and permissions
- [ ] Site/group consent assessed and evidenced through a private appropriate channel
- [ ] Workers/participants may freely decline without penalty
- [ ] Risks to children and vulnerable people assessed by relevant specialists if implicated

## Safety and public trust
- [ ] Possible physical, legal, social and privacy harms reviewed
- [ ] No profiling, coercion, covert access, doxxing, harassment or targeted persuasion
- [ ] Risk-flag answers independently questioned rather than taken at face value
- [ ] Data minimized; private reports stay outside GitHub

## Accessibility and fairness
- [ ] Equivalently meaningful remote/low-cost options
- [ ] Burdens and potential unintended harms assessed with affected people
- [ ] Does not reward ideology or assign a moral score

## Claims and evidence
- [ ] Proposed outcome, baseline and limitations clearly distinguished
- [ ] No unverified claim of impact or institutional rehabilitation
- [ ] Independent correction and complaint route exists

## Outcome
- [ ] Request revisions
- [ ] Reject unsafe or non-consensual proposal
- [ ] Recommend for future qualified review **(not approved for publication)**

## Remaining blockers
Explain what must be resolved before any real-world pilot or platform publication.

This repository has no operational publication authority as of v0.3. Only draft intake is supported.
